name: VectorMap Visitors Globe Lite
author: vectormapper

sections.description:
Lite globe visitor counter (Classic skin). Shows a 3D globe via shortcode and counts visits only on that page. Uses Mapbox GL; stores data in uploads.

VectorMap Visitors Globe Lite

  • Shortcode: [visitors_globe_lite title="VISITORS" width="100%" height="600"]
  • On activation, static viewer files are copied to /wp-content/uploads/visitors-lite/ (if missing).
  • Visit data is stored in /wp-content/uploads/visitors-lite/visitors.json (no custom DB tables).
  • No calls home; no personal data is collected.

VectorMap Visitors Globe Lite

  1. Upload the plugin and activate it.
  2. Place the shortcode on a page: [visitors_globe_lite].
  3. Open the page — an iframe renders the globe from /uploads/visitors-lite/index.html and the plugin logs a visit.

VectorMap Visitors Globe Lite

This plugin does not collect personal data. It uses Mapbox GL JS and tiles from api.mapbox.com to render the globe. Site owners can replace the token by overwriting files under /uploads/visitors-lite/.

VectorMap Visitors Globe Lite

= 1.1.4 =
– Updated: Tested up to 6.8
– Removed: load_plugin_textdomain() (WP.org auto-loads translations for slug)
– Removed: Domain Path header; no languages folder is shipped
– Removed: hidden files in assets/seed; filtered unsafe filenames
– Security: uploads .htaccess created on activation (not shipped)
– Escaping/sanitization and AJAX logging retained

Usage

Shortcodes:

[visitors_globe_lite]
[visitors_globe_lite skin=”classic”]
[visitors_globe_lite skin=”landcover”]
[visitors_globe_lite title=”VISITORS” width=”100%” height=”600″ skin=”landcover”]

  • skin: classic (default) | landcover
